whatWasBuilt: packages/swing-lab/src/labelQueueV2.ts — deterministic active-learning scoring CLI (pnpm lab:label-queue): score = bucketThinness (1/(1+committed label count)) × measured modality failure impact × committed-evidence slice boosts ÷ per-modality acquisition cost. No RNG, no timestamps in ranking, stable tie-breaks (score desc, id asc).

packages/swing-lab/test/labelQueueV2.test.ts — 7 vitest tests on synthetic fixtures: thinness math, per-modality counting (null contactMs excluded), held-out exclusion even when files exist on disk, boost application with provenance, determinism (byte-identical repeated runs), rank/sort invariants, provenance completeness for every item.

datasets/experiments/wave-d2/label-queue-v2.json — top-30 ranked bundle×modality label buckets with per-item reasoning and full scoreInputs provenance (annotation source files, quoted artifact metrics for impacts and boosts, cost rationale).

scoreInputProvenance.bucketThinness: counted live from committed annotation sidecars datasets/paddle-bench/bundles/*/annotation/*.json (held-out wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 excluded from candidate generation entirely)
scoreInputProvenance.failureImpact: constants quoting EXP-2026-08-28-cascade-waterfall.json (conditional CONTACT 2/5, STROKE 1/5, rally1 0%-overlap event selection, rally2 BALL_BODY_OVERLAP), docs/HANDOFF_V3.md §2/§3/§6/rule 17, wave-b/W12-summary.json (edge-on/blur miss windows), wave-c/c04-ball-gold-summary.json (8 occlusion-adjacent labels), wave-c/c18-stroke-taxonomy-labels-summary.json (L3 known 8/22)
scoreInputProvenance.acquisitionCost: documented relative frames-to-view constants per modality (ball 1, ownership 1.5, stroke 3, contact 4 per C05 frame-stepping method, events 6)

honestNegatives: Impact weights are ordinal constants justified by quoted committed measurements, not learned coefficients; no canonical runs exist on this Linux box to fit them (pose extraction is macOS-only).
Bucket granularity is bundle×modality; sub-event slices (e.g. specific occlusion windows) are expressed as multiplicative boosts, not separate queue rows.
No new labels were created in this workstream; the queue directs future labeling only.
Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never viewed, labeled, or scored.
